run_train_iteration: run a single training iteration on a transformer model with batch splitting and hidden state caching
run_full_eval: run a full evaluation pass over data to compute average loss for a transformer model
run_train_step: run a single training step computing loss and backward pass for an adaptive span transformer model

review_train_iteration: review the train_iteration function to understand how it handles data slicing, cache resetting, and position randomization
